summary: A senator has committed to making DC statehood a top priority, while advocacy groups mark the anniversary of a federal deployment of National Guard troops to the District and a federal takeover, both of which they say underscore the need for statehood. Without statehood, the District's National Guard answers to the President, not to the officials D.C. residents elect.

articles.title: VIDEO: Senator Slotkin Commits to Making DC Statehood a Top Priority
One Year Later, DC Vote Says Federal Takeover Underscores the Urgency of DC Statehood
One Year After President Trump Deployed National Guard Troops to Washington, D.C., Statehood is More Important Than Ever
